name: ai-plugins
description: Performance Dudes — public Claude Code plugins (signing, workspace infrastructure) and reference examples.

plugins.name: example
plugins.description: Reference showcase of every Claude Code plugin component and technique — workflow, command, skill (calling the workflow), subagent, theme, output style, plus .example templates for hooks/MCP/LSP/monitors and a tests/ folder on how to test plugins and skills. Command: /greet

plugins.name: context-aware
plugins.description: Reference plugin for building context-aware plugins: workflows and agents that route ALL retrieval through the context-mode MCP (ctx_*), so raw bytes are indexed and searched in a sandbox, never dumped into the window. Requires context-mode (enabled once at the workspace level). Teaches the five patterns (index-once-slice-many, fetch-and-index, plain-JS glue, structured-output handoffs, lean orchestrator) and ships a runnable, domain-agnostic demo. Command: /context-aware

plugins.name: workspace-context
plugins.description: Set up bounded Context Mode indexing for a large repository or a parent workspace containing sibling repositories. Creates explicit project-local AGENTS.md and session-start hook guidance without bundling the external context-mode runtime. Command: /workspace-context:workspace-context

plugins.name: transcribe
plugins.description: Quality-first multi-speaker transcription on Apple Silicon — an on-device ffmpeg/Whisper/pyannote pipeline plus parallel Opus deliverables (verbatim clean transcript, minutes, quoted facts, personas, todos). Generic: all domain knowledge comes from user-provided context. Command: /transcribe

plugins.name: ocr
plugins.description: Quality-first OCR + auto-classification of scanned documents on Apple Silicon — on-device Apple Vision OCR (auge, auto-rotating) plus parallel Opus classification into a reviewable rename/sort proposal, with a separate dry-run apply step (undo log, searchable PDF text layers). Generic: all domain knowledge comes from user-provided context. Command: /ocr

plugins.name: image-toolkit
plugins.description: Image create & edit framework — Google Gemini for AI generation and semantic editing (recommended path), plus ImageMagick 7 for fast local processing (resize, crop, convert, watermark, favicon, batch, GIF, montage). Bundled generate_image.py runs via uv (no manual deps). Generic: prompts and assets come from the user. Command: /image

plugins.name: content-craft
plugins.description: Research-backed content & design craft — two generic user-space skills: blog-article-writing (AIDA/PAS frameworks, headline patterns, readability, editing checklist) and design-skills-2026 (WCAG 2.1 AA, Core Web Vitals, mobile-first responsive UI, typography, motion, onboarding UI patterns). Generic, evidence-based — no PD IP. Conversion-/PLG-psychology lives in the sales plugin.

plugins.name: mechanic
plugins.description: Cost-tiered mechanical subagents — two agents pinned to cheaper model versions so the premium tier (Opus / Sonnet 5) stays reserved for judgment. `mechanic` (Sonnet 4.6) for mechanical work that needs code/context comprehension (specified edits, cross-file refactors, boilerplate that must fit); `errand` (Haiku 4.5) for trivial self-contained transformations that need no codebase understanding (classify, extract, reformat, literal find/replace). Routing: needs code understanding -> mechanic; needs a decision -> general-purpose; otherwise -> errand. Invoke via the Agent tool with subagent_type "mechanic" or "mechanic:errand".

plugins.name: terminal
plugins.description: Per-project terminal identity for iTerm2 — a Dynamic Profile that switches automatically when you enter the project directory, showing a wallpaper, an accent color shared by tab and cursor, and a translucent badge in the top-right corner that renders the live Claude Code session name. Ships the recipe as a skill, an idempotent installer that resolves machine-specific asset paths and degrades loudly instead of rendering a silently blank background, and a worked template. Command: /iterm-profile

plugins.name: anti-slop
plugins.description: Detects and removes LLM slop from business and narrative prose in English and German. 1894 entries (1856 distinct terms) across four grep-checked lists — 517 upstream EQ-Bench, 772 curated English, 496 German, 109 language-neutral (stock names and places, chatbot artifacts, unfilled placeholders) — each curated term carrying a hard/soft severity, plus a flexion-aware checker so German inflected forms are actually found. Lists are never loaded into context.
